Use the complete post to interpret the fixed subject and the source wording, including idioms and implied meanings. The mask's fragments must together convey the supplied subject's whole meaning at its level of generality. Select expressions of that meaning, not descriptions of particular examples that merely demonstrate it.

Within each occurrence, keep the wording needed to express the supplied meaning and remove wording that adds meaning beyond it. Preserve every detail specified by the subject. An expression is still too specific if it retains a detail absent from the subject, even after other words have been removed. Fragments may be individual words and need not form grammatical prose.

Select every occurrence contributing to the supplied meaning in context, including repeated expressions within words and hashtags. An occurrence may express only part of the subject and need other fragments to complete it. Do not omit it because that part is already expressed elsewhere. Do not include unrelated uses merely because their wording matches.
